who.value: someone about to sell, casual or first-time

job.value: choose between listing an item themselves and selling directly to Carousell

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'List anything yourself' and 'Sell to Carousell' side by side state the choice the page is for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Select photos' button inside the large drop zone is the most noticeable element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Select photos' and 'List multiple items' are clear, but the 'Mobile — Doorstep pickup' / 'Luxury — Highest offer in the market' tiles don't say what clicking starts (a quote, a form, a booking).

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Find your own buyers' and 'No listing needed, sell directly to us' explain the two paths in plain words.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks one decision a seller can make: list it myself, or sell this category to Carousell.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each option is a single line; details come after a choice is made.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything here is about starting to sell.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Two headings, short subtitles and tile labels; nothing to read through.
